text:
I was a loyal customer in the neighborhood. But the way they handle their business is extremely unfriendly. It's disturbing and unreasonable to enforce such a strict cancellation policy during the pandemic. My dinner date was feeling sick. I called the restaurant and explained the difficult situation and that I didn't want to put the restaurant server and other customers at risk. And that I could reschedule the dinner. But they refused to give me that option and insisted on charging me a $100 cancellation fee. 

Super disappointed and I don't recommend anyone going there if you want to be treated with decency.

I've been here a few times now and have tried a number of different menu items. I've never been disappointed! The made to order items are just as delicious as the pastries. I highly recommend trying the croque-madame (a French dish, it's a grilled ham and cheese sandwich with a fried egg on top). They make it on their homemade bread, which is nice and thick.
My search for the best pad Thai in south tampa is finally over!! I've tried a ton and hands down Thai 5 is the best!

I. Love. This. Place.

Whenever I have friends visiting from out of town, this is where I take them! My favorite items here are the stuffed French toast and the Mexi scramble. Pesto in eggs? Who would have known? 

The Mexi scramble seems basic, but is SO flavorful and delicious -- I crave it constantly and have never had anything like it anywhere else. At a certain point, there's only so much you can do with eggs, until Sabrina's proves you wrong!

Get the stuffed French toast -- thank me later. If you're more of a savory breakfast person but want to try it, pro tip: THEY OFFER HALF ORDERS! Seriously some of the BEST French toast I have ever eaten in my life. Whatever fluffy cream they stuff that toast with is stuff straight from heaven. No exaggeration. Pure bliss.

Bonus: they have sriracha AND Cholula here, which is basically the best thing ever.

I recommend getting on their waitlist if you're coming on a busy weekend during peak hours -- this is an easy and convenient system and the staff is always super helpful and it goes smoothly. Restrooms are clean, and the restaurant is beautiful. 

Before coming to Sabrina's, I really thought brunch was so normalized and I had seen it all in all it's variations -- thank you for proving me wrong and getting me excited to get up early enough to share a meal here!

In town for an overnight stay and wanted something within walking  distance from our hotel.

Awful, slow service at 5:25 pm and the restaurant is not even at capacity due to COVID 19.

Will never return

Great food and even better customer service.  A coworker and myself on business in Edmonton for the week decided to leave the hotel area and head downtown for a good meal.  On the recommendation of trip advisor we were directed to Meat, a bbq smokehouse in the downtown core.  I had been once before on another business trip about 2 years ago and the experience was decent overall.  This subsequent visit was outstanding.  In addition to the well prepared food, our server Melissa Doro was exceptional.  A very welcoming and vibrant personality, great direction and recommendations on the menu and consistent check-ins to ensure we had what we needed and that the food was as good as it should be.  The brisket was moist and well smoked.  The cauliflower was simply delicious.  The fried chicken was crisp and tasty.  The ribs however were not on par with the rest of the meal.  Melissa however had taken note and ensured we received a fresh, not overcooked and delicious replacement which was unexpected but very much appreciated.  The finger bowls to clean up following the meal was also a nice and welcoming touch.  Melissa felt she had done nothing special and just did what she believed her job entailed.  That may be the case but her level of attentiveness and overall customer service is a rare experience these days and made this visit worth the trip downtown.  Needless to stay, the next trip to Edmonton will include a visit to Meat for some delicious eats and my new favourite server.  Tha
Their pizza is always so delicious and they are so pleasant whenever I am there to pick up! Highly recommend! Their sauce is so yummy and a nice thin crust.

Really wanted to like this place after hearing great things. But, my order just wasn't good. I ordered the Rize upside down or inside out pizza and the cheese was a thick layer of hardness that we could barely bite through and there was no sauce on it.
The ribeye egg rolls weren't good either. 
Two things that were good were the beet salad and the truffle fries. I am hesitant to try again. My sister ordered before and loved it then ordered the same day that we did and said it wasn't good either, maybe they had an off night or have a new cook?
Order was 2 hrs late.  And an Italian sandwich short.  One hour later the Italian sandwich arrives and with chunk ham. Really!!! It has cut up canned ham in chunks on an Italian sub.
HOLY SHISH KEBAB this place is awesome. Highly recommend the lamb gyro and Greek fries! Love the house made sauces.

Tried the Shrimp Po-Boy and it was the best of the 3 I have tried.  Bread was very soft.
The oysters were very flavorful.
The s'mores cake was rich and sweet.
Service was good.

Great takeout experience. Ordered online and food was ready in 15 minutes. Also this food is DELICIOUS. We ordered the duck taco as an appetizer (came with two tacos), I had the Khao Soi, and my boo ordered guey tiew gai. He said the chicken in the guey tiew gai is off the chart - it was freshly seared and brought together the whole soup. The khao soi was also great - it's a creamy yellow curry but the spice combination is authentic and delicious. Duck tacos was a perfect app to order with the soup. Would order it again.

We both ordered Level 2 spicy and it hit the place for me, had a little kick to it but nothing overwhelming (I'm a spice enthusiast too - so take this from my perspective). 

Will definitely be coming back!

The fried green tomatoes. The fried oyster po-boy. The creamy grits. The crawfish gumbo with the okra. The Bourbon pecan pie. The sassy, retro chic waitress. It's been 2 weeks, but I still think about that meal...
Thank for the hookup guys it was great. I'll be back again soon! Very impressed in the options and quality and the dog bowl too! Great idea . Show some love peeps
Great sushi!Portion sizes are nice. Tried the fried rice, pad Thai and some sushi rolls. I definitely recommend the sushi. The fried rice and pad Thai wasn't my fav. Will go again for only sushi.

My favorite restaurant in the entire city. When I die, please bury me here. 
I always order half chicken.

Really excited to see another locally owned business in this part of town! Baby's should make your list for all the things- Work meeting? Check. Date night? Check. Family in town? Check. 

All around it was a great experience- from easy parking, no wait for patio seating, a straightforward menu, and quick service, it was all spot on. 

The food was good. But unfortunately,  I didn't think it was anything special- especially for the price. However,
That may be able to be overlooked by many because of all the other wonderful features of this local joint! Was just hoping for a little bit more of a wow factor!

I wish I had a chance to write a good review about the goat as I have heard so many great things about it. My brother, his wife, and I went there today to celebrate my brothers birthday.... we even brought a cake. We were looking forward to this more than usual as it was to help take our minds off the recent and unexpected passing of their baby daughter. 
The hostess was very nice and seated us promptly to a table just to the side of the hostess stand. As we watched the other tables be waited on again and again, we saw us being passed by. My sister-in-law finally got up to ask the host about a waitress, then we sat there for a few more minutes watching waitresses standing at the host stand, we got up to leave frustrated and upset.  As we walked out all they had to say was "we're sorry". But they will never understand how sorry we are that they did not get to celebrate not only my brother's birthday with us but also the celebration of my niece becoming an angel.

My meal arrived without silverware, I was told to get it myself, my meal was missing half of what it said it came, because they ran out,  and charged me full price. I won't be back and I don't recommend coming here
Love the chargrilled oysters! Been coming here for years. The pecan cobbler with ice cream is delicious too so save room for dessert!

Quite enjoyed my take out experience at El Dorado. I was hungry after taking fir baby to vet across street so ran in and ordered a fajita salad and ran back to car - fur baby still in car. 7 min later food ready - packed with utensils and chips and salsa and done.
Salsa was wonderful- thicker than most and wonderful flavor. 
People there were so nice and helpful. Glad I stopped. Would definitely go again. Parking easy peasy.
Amazing food, great service and perfect atmosphere! So happy to have Enza in the neighborhood!!

One of the best restaurant experiences I've had in a long time! 

My friends and I decided to come here after hearing great things and knowing how good the restaurant Peche is (I believe they are owned by the same people?). It was easy to get reservations online the week of so I was surprised to see how crowded it was when we arrived (not a single table was empty and there were a few parties waiting). The hostesses were very friendly and had no qualms about letting me sit at the table while I waited for my friends to arrive. The restaurant itself is gorgeous-spacious and modern with a beautiful open kitchen area, will definitely stand out among the sea of other great restaurants in the area.  

The food was wonderful! We ordered all 5 of the small antipasti plates (marinated olives, tuna-stuffed peppers, caprese salad, eggplant, and mushrooms). Our favorite was the eggplant! The portions are small so this was the perfect amount to split between 3 people to get a little taste of everything. We also ordered some focaccia bread (YUM) and each ordered a pasta dish...delicious!! I had the rigatoni with walnut pesto and it was perfection. I also tried a bite of my friend's carbonara and it was absolutely divine!! It totally had me wanting to come back just for a bowl of that warm, creamy, bacon-y goodness. They also have some great wines by the glass as well as tasty cocktails with classic Italian flavors (think Campari and Aperol). 

The real kicker of this whole dining experience

When I first moved to St Louis in late 2016, I was happy to have found Wudon in 2017. For the record, I lived in Seoul for a while and being able to find a 'beef & leaf' joint was awesome. It was pricey but good, key word "was". Sadly over the last 3 years their quality has gone downhill and their one good server is no longer there. The service sucks. You have to ask multiple times to get things, when the staff walk by and see empty drink glasses on the table, they don't offer refills. They no longer offer refills on banyan either. They'll not pre-bus the table, was not a one time deal either, this has been over multiple visits. But no more, I will not give any more chances.

This review is not about the friendliness of the staff or the atmosphere. When I arrived I was greeted by a very polite host. Once my group was seated we ordered a pitcher of a strawberry margarita. First we had to wait 10 minutes for the pitcher to arrive because it fell at the bar. Additionally, the pitcher was only 32 ounces (this is stated in the menu), which could have been fine if it did not consist of 50% ice. Due to the excessive amount of ice, the pitcher only filled three, 7 ounce plastic cups. It was $33 + tip,  poorly spent. If this is how the restaurant serves their pitchers, they should suggest that one pitcher might not be enough for three customers.
Great little bar in Nashville! Listened to WCB- Wes Cook Band and drinks were reasonable! ($5.00 beers) They serve food but we didn't order any this time. Would come back!

FRIDAY, FRIDAY, except today is Saturday.  Social dis is a good thang but I couldn't help but to notice some customers were without mask! Food was disappointing and the service as well.  Don't worry I won't be back at this one.

Taste of India on the more eastern end of the Loop is absolutely the best Indian cuisine on Delmar and certainly one of the best in the area. The proprietors recognized me as a regular at one of their previous establishments. Its always nice to be remembered. Service and food is always good. I normally get the same things, Pakora, Butter Chicken or Tikka and naan. All are very good here.
The cat head chicken biscuits were amazing! Well worth the 40 minute wait. The mimosa was tasty champagne with a splash of juice, unlike most that like to put juice with a splash of champagne.

Really delicious. Glad they are open! I got the Matcha Ice cream with vanilla cake and red bean sauce. I like that they have flavors like matcha and ube. I am excited to try it again! Owner is really thorough cleaning in between customers and is really friendly!

This was my favorite food stop during my weekend trip to New Orleans. Yes, the food was great but the service was great too! They ran out of the legs that came with the Taste of New Orleans and forgot to tell us. However, they quickly replaced with the snow crab without any charge! Me and my friend were so happy. The Taste of New Orleans is good for two people. It was priced reasonable and I highly recommend for you to try this. We got their special sauce with it and we definitely finished that sauce LOL! It was so delicious, I will definitely come back again. PS, one serving of rice can be small, you might need two.

If you love high quality gourmet pizza this place won't let you down. Plus the service was excellent you could see how the server would anticipate our smiles when she delivered our food choices. Thank you so much the a great lunch

Delicious food, ample portions, great prices, friendly service!

Since I'm type 1 diabetic & eat low carb, I ordered the low carb grilled chicken salad & it was perfect. The guys make it right in front of you so you can choose what you want. The chicken was excellent - moist & flavorful. Fantastic feta. Drizzled in ranch. Look at the picture. It's a masterpiece. 

My wife ordered the falafel plate. She liked the cucumber dipping sauce & said the falafel was unique - lighter/less dense than others we've had, but still filling.

We'll definitely be coming back!

My new favorite Mexican restaurant.  Yes the food is good, but the real treat is the service.  Chips & salsa almost immediately, water immediately, fast, courteous and welcoming!  Great outdoor space too!
I came here with a few friends for happy hour. After a lot of hype it was only okay. The food was decent, but nothing got rave about.

Had breakfast here a week ago and still thinking about the bacon special which was truly finger licking good.  Meal was wonderful.  Place was crazy busy so getting their app helped with a quick seating.  Only complaint was the hot chocolate.  It looked great but was too weak.  

Returned for another wonderful breakfast ended up getting the same meal and I was not disappointed!!

First time to this joint. Prob won't be my last either. Place is bomb! Nice portions for the price. Good tasting food. Service was just what ya need and ownership and management read well as the informative article of them displayed on the wall near the entrance, mentions!

I've only ever ordered takeout here but I can say I've never been disappointed and it's good quality for takeout sushi. Fresh sushi, good hot foods, not oily. They have a variety of asian cuisine so there's something for everyone ! 
Friendly delivery service from the restaurant directly. I pickup when I can because it'll save ~$10 off your bill.
Sandy was our server last night, she was on top of everything. We didn't have to ask for refills for our drinks. The food was worth every penny!

Simple. Best meal of the Covid year! Amazing flavor. Great service. Ample spacing between tables for social distancing. Staff wearing masks correctly. This place never fails for its price point. In my top 5 places to eat in Indy.

Didn't expect it but, Penrose Diner was certainly phenomenal. Flavorful menu items and outstanding service. Probably the most tasty menu item for me was Turkey Club. The working staff was very attentive and extremely knowledgeable of the menu items. I definitely see myself returning here in the future.

My sister and I took a day trip to Nashville and we just had to stop by a Frothy Monkey - and I'm so glad we were able to! Our iced monkey mocha latte was everything! This review is a couple days late - but shout out to the Friday night shift crew for being so accommodating and friendly! Y'all are rockstars.

Been driving past this place for a while, decided to finally come in and give it a try. The environment is awesome. Really open space, bringing the outside in, trees inside. Loved the space. Ordering was a bit of a mess as there were only little Togo menus and you could only order on screen, but the on screen did not provide any information about the food. I have a lot of good allergies so I found this difficult and a little inconvenient. I ended up with eggs, vegan cheese, turkey bacon, spinach, and tomatoes, a peach tea for a drink, and sweet potatoes as a side. The food was ordered and they brought it to the table, they mixed up my companion and my order, but it was all sorted out. Flavor of the food was not there. It was very bland. Nothing more, nothing less than what I ordered. Nothing stood out. Bland food I can deal with, it was after I left that I realized I was having a reaction to their food. I have a dairy allergy and thought I would be safe with what I selected. I'm not sure if they put milk in their eggs or if someone mistakenly gave me regular cheese when they mixed up my companion and my food. But after eating here I immediately became very ill. Save yourself time and money and don't dine here. It's good for pictures, but nothing more.

Our first trip to Nashville but fourth day we discovered the Famous Saloon. What a find!  The singers performing were the best we had heard from about 25 different performances we had listened to. Our server Shelly, was fantastic!  She was super sweet and provided excellent service. We never ran out of drinks at any point. We have had some terrible service in Nashville but this was by far the best in town! Thanks Shelly for being our best server!We had appetizers as well and they were very good too. 
The floors, tables and restrooms were all very clean as well.

Horrible. I spent $65 on three items to be delivered. The woman delivering my order texted me that my food was left at my door which in fact it was NOT because I was standing outside waiting for it. Then I called her asking where my food Was
was and she said she dropped the food off at #903 which I specifically wrote my apartment number two different times at check out. I watched her pick up my pizza that was left outside another apartment door and brought it to me. The food was so cold by the time I got it and the wings were absolutely horrible, tasted like old grease.

Horrible location! We were seated and sat for 9 minutes before I am assuming our server literally tossed napkins and silverware on our table while yelling to another table "give me one minute!" Not a single word or eye contact with or to us! He went and printed a receipt delivered it to a table, then went to ANOTHER table and at that point we got up and left. NEVER AGAIN WILL we come to this location. Carrollwood is much better and well worth the drive!!!

Was kinda not expecting this place to be in a hotel but ok , they offered valet which was for free which was nice! The place was cute ! They had a cactus Christmas tree , loud atmosphere everyone was into the tequila trees , but enjoyable . Started off with a spicy margarita which was phenomenal , and had the blue crab street corn which wasn't as great as I thought , which it seems to be a very popular choice , also we got the nacho which was really
Good and the portion was pretty big my Husband didn't like that it came in a metal pan because he said he could taste the metal in some of the bites of his food . For our entrees we got the pecan crusted carnitas, the brisket enchiladas, and brisket tamales , was looking to get the duck empanadas but they weren't on the menu , portions were small but most entree came with rice and beans. And the food was delish I enjoyed it all

Placed a pick up order at BJ's Brewhouse and when we got it home, realized they left out the desert. Sat down to eat and my phone rang. It was BJ's saying they were sorry they forgot it and are sending me a gift card to get it at a later date so I don't have to come back. Although, my meat wasn't cooked as I requested, I'm very impressed that they were proactive and I didn't even have a chance to call. Good job BJ's!
Our new go-to sushi place. Coming from LA I'm pretty picky when it comes to my sushi & this place gives me my fix. It's very fresh and has a great variety of dishes.
Docs is the absolute best bbq in town! They do an awesome job on their burnt ends, if you order them in time!  They do sell out of things frequently bc they are just that awesome!
